scripts.dev: bun run build:workers && bun scripts/bundle.mjs --code-only && bun run tauri -- dev --config apps/desktop/tauri.conf.json
scripts.prepare:bundle: bun run build:workers && bun scripts/bundle.mjs && bun run verify:bundle
scripts.package: bun run vendor && bun run prepare:bundle && bun run tauri -- build --config apps/desktop/tauri.conf.json
scripts.package:offline: bun run vendor && bun run prepare:bundle && bun run tauri -- build --config apps/desktop/tauri.conf.json --config apps/desktop/tauri.offline.conf.json
scripts.package:release: bun run vendor && bun run prepare:bundle && bun run tauri -- build --config apps/desktop/tauri.conf.json --config apps/desktop/tauri.release.conf.json
